# SlimManager

> Free, lightweight task manager for gamers on Windows and Mac. Customizable live dashboard (CPU, GPU, RAM, network, drives) with 7 skins and your own background; tap any tile to see which app uses how much. Game Boost freezes background clutter and prioritizes the game, with an exceptions list (headset software, Discord, OBS, anti-cheat always safe). Focus mode for quiet work (calmer fans, Windows Update paused). Live stats, process list (sort by CPU/GPU/RAM) and boost control on your phone or tablet via QR code – no app install, secure pairing. Mini overlay. Under 1 % CPU in the background. No account, no ads, no cloud. By SlimBit Apps.

- [Download](https://slimbitapps.github.io/SlimManager/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/slimbitapps/SlimManager)
